scenarios.label: Fresh install
scenarios.purpose: Prove a trusted package installs for a standard user without a source checkout.
assertions: Makers Anvil appears as an installed application

scenarios.label: First launch
scenarios.purpose: Prove the installed application starts and creates only portable app-owned user data.
assertions: runtime data uses the platform user-data location

scenarios.label: Upgrade preserves data
scenarios.purpose: Prove a higher package version replaces the application while preserving user settings and projects.

scenarios.label: Repair
scenarios.purpose: Prove trusted package repair restores application payload without replacing user data.

scenarios.label: Uninstall preserves data
scenarios.purpose: Prove package removal unregisters application payload while preserving app-owned user data by default.

scenarios.label: Reinstall after removal
scenarios.purpose: Prove a later trusted install can reuse preserved data without a source checkout.
assertions: native launch and local API health pass
